canonical_event_instance_grain.grain_statement: one native session_opened Event Instance per event_type_id + exchange_id + session_date + calendar_version + governed open timestamp

event_instance_id_policy.determinism_rule: same governed exchange-session occurrence under same registry and calendar authority yields same event_instance_id
event_instance_id_policy.correction_rule: changed calendar authority, corrected open timestamp or changed calendar_row_fingerprint requires versioning or supersession, not silent overwrite

timestamp_policy.first_observable_timestamp_utc: calendar authority may make the scheduled open knowable before the occurrence; the event occurrence cannot be true before event_anchor_timestamp_utc
timestamp_policy.binding_created_at_utc: required only when a future execution creates a registry or dataset row
timestamp_policy.source_record_effective_from: optional lineage field if the calendar source exposes an effective-from timestamp
forbidden_timestamp_equivalence: calendar knowledge timestamp == event occurrence timestamp

detector_policy.rationale: session_opened is sourced from governed calendar authority, not inferred from price or trade observations

instrument_projection_policy.projection_statement: one exchange-session Event Instance may be associated with many instrument-session contexts under a future design; that association cannot alter the native event_instance_id
instrument_projection_policy.instrument_halted_at_open_policy: does_not_invalidate_exchange_session_event; belongs to future instrument projection, Market State, Event State or Execution State policy

exception_policy.weekends: no instance when no governed trading session row exists
exception_policy.holidays: no instance when no governed trading session row exists; holiday absence inference is not an Event Instance
exception_policy.exceptional_closures: follow governed calendar authority; corrections require supersession/version policy
exception_policy.delayed_exchange_openings: not admitted unless encoded by governed calendar authority or future event type
exception_policy.early_closes: do not change session_opened anchor but must be preserved as calendar lineage where available
exception_policy.dst_transitions: resolved only through governed calendar timestamps and timezone authority
